properties.notes: Former Council offices within town centre location, including existing buildings and area of car parking. Largely vacant and out of use and the building is highly likely to be surplus to requirements in the medium-term. However, a small element of the building is occupied by a tenant, with the lease extant until 2022. Demolition and clearance of the existing buildings will be required prior to progression of a scheme. An above average density could be suitable given the central location within Bedlington. Therefore, the site is not immediately available and would represent a longer-term option for redevelopment once vacant. Currently considered developable later in the plan period.
